title: Fivefold Akam Love: The Fourth Stage of Physical Manifestations
paragraphs: The sweet clandestine union having enjoyed, The lovers part With hearts full of love.
The kindred folks spot them. With an open-hearted praise of the lady, The hero said: “I have resolved to marry her”. But the people of the village are not amused.

Taunt and rebuke mark their words “How dare you inform us after everything is over?” Seeing the kinsmen in frenzy, The lady casts off her shyness and speaks with resolve: “After the decision of ‘he for me’ and ‘I for him’. Why should there be a wall in between? Let it be shattered to pieces.” “How could she wag her tongue so After having led a secret love course?” They bare their fang. Dismayed, the lady’s heart is filled with woe. She then accepts the gift of the hero as per the ancient custom. “What is left now Is only fixing the marriage date.” Saying so She leaves the place Wishing her critics well.

> The heroine’s ecstatic recollecting and praise > Of the hero’s acts of love towards her, > Her utterances shorn of her native credulousness, > Being down with coyness at the gossip > The unkind tongues of the town indulge in about their love, > And her willing acceptance of the hero’s gifts of love -- > Such are the externalizations of the fourth phase > That mark the clandestine love career of the two.
Note: Once marriage is confirmed, the hero will offer a gift to the heroine which is called kaiyuṟai.
